question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for each department, the minimum number of enrolled students in Chemistry department subjects offered in '2019FA' with course materials and more than 0 enrolled students, calculated in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses, inner_cte.window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each school, provide the school name, the average and variance of the department budget codes for all departments and subject codes associated with that school, and also include the total number of unique subject codes per school. Only include the departments Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC;

question: For each subject code and department name in the Mathematics department, where the course is degree granting and the subject is offered in the current academic year, provide the number of unique subject titles, the minimum total units, and indicate whether the minimum total units is above, below, or equal to the average total units for that department and subject code this year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), avg_units_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.num_unique_subject_titles, i.min_total_units, a.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > a.avg_total_units THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.min_total_units < a.avg_total_units THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'EQUAL_TO_AVERAGE' END AS min_units_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_units_cte a ON i.SUBJECT_CODE = a.SUBJECT_CODE AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of all subjects offered in that year by the Mathematics department (considering only years with more than 10 subjects), and for each subject in those years, what is the subject id, its total units, and the deviation of its total units from the average total units for that year? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 10 ) , avg_units_per_year AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.stddev_total_units, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, (ccso.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_units_per_year a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.SUBJECT_ID ;

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest number of graduate students in degree-granting departments, display each department's name, total graduate student count, the school it belongs to, the most common course description among its graduate students, and the count of students in that course. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_graduate_students, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, cdc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS Most_Common_Course, cdc.Student_Count FROM ( SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY total_graduate_students DESC LIMIT 10 ) ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS Student_Count, @rank := IF(@current_dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, @rank + 1, 1) AS `Rank`, @current_dept := sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_dept := '') vars WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, Student_Count DESC ) cdc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cdc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cdc.`Rank` = 1 ORDER BY ic.total_graduate_students DESC;

question: For each DLC, what is the DLC key, DLC name, the number of unique organizations, and the total number of assignable organizations, considering only DLCs that have at least one assignable organization, whose DLC name contains the word 'Office', and that are not the biology department? Additionally, for each such DLC, what is the average organization level of its assignable organizations? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assignable_organization_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.DLC_NAME LIKE '%Office%' AND LOWER(o.DLC_NAME) != LOWER('Biology') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME ) SELECT i.DLC_KEY, i.DLC_NAME, i.organization_count, i.assignable_organization_count, AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_assignable_org_level FROM inner_cte i JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON i.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY i.DLC_KEY, i.DLC_NAME, i.organization_count, i.assignable_organization_count;

question: For all buildings on the MIT site that are academic buildings with more than 50 rooms (according to the building history) and are specifically the Ray and Maria Stata Center, list each floor's number, the total assignable area on that floor, and the total non-assignable area, ordered by floor number. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) AS num_floors FROM FCLT_FLOOR ff JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 50 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' OR fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32') ) SELECT ff.FLOOR, SUM(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area, SUM(ff.NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_non_assignable_area FROM FCLT_FLOOR ff JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 50 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' OR fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32') GROUP BY ff.FLOOR ORDER BY ff.FLOOR;

question: For each DLC in the history department, provide the DLC name, the average and variance of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC (excluding organizations '138' and '250' and only considering non-null organization numbers and DLC keys), and classify each DLC as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if the variance is at least 20% greater than the average variance across all such DLCs, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if the variance is at least 20% less than the average variance, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fodk.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, AVG(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_organization_number, VARIANCE(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS var_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fodk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(fo.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History') AND fo.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY fodk.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME ), variance_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(var_organization_number) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DLC_KEY, i.DLC_NAME, i.avg_organization_number, i.var_organization_number, CASE WHEN i.var_organization_number > v.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.var_organization_number < v.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN variance_benchmark v;

question: For all rooms with an area greater than 400 in the Stata building, show the room key, building room, area, the subject title and academic year of each course meeting in that room that is offered by the Computer Science department, and also include the department name and the rank of each room within its building (ordered by room key). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t1.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each organization, what is the highest HR department code (old) among its associated HR org units, what is the HR department name, and what is the corresponding HR org unit title, considering only organizations whose highest HR department code (old) is greater than 500000, and excluding organizations named 'ADMISSIONS'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS max_hr_dept_code_old, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) > 500000 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.max_hr_dept_code_old, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY AND inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.max_hr_dept_code_old = hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD;

question: For each department that grants degrees, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, and only include those departments whose average total units is above the overall average total units across all degree-granting departments? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg FROM ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_avgs ) o ON i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg ORDER BY i.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each organization whose organization level is 5 and is not 'ADMISSIONS', show the organization name, description, the corresponding space unit name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the space unit name, but exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'. Then, from these results, return only those organizations whose organization name starts with the letter 'C'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND t0.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE ORGANIZATION_NAME LIKE 'C%';

question: For each course in the Mathematics department that is degree granting and has a course level of 'G', show the course description, department name, school name, and the dense rank over the administrative department name ordered by the administrative department name. Additionally, for each administrative department name, include a grand total of the number of such courses in the format of (null, null, null, administrative department name, total courses). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), CourseTotals AS ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.admin_dept_dense_rank, NULL AS total_courses FROM inner_cte ic UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, ct.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL, ct.total_courses FROM CourseTotals ct ORDER BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION

question: For each organization that has a non-null description, belongs to the 'Standard Hierarchy' type, is not the 'Cambridge-MIT Institute', and where the department is 'Political Science' (Course 17), show the organization name, department name, department code, department hierarchy level 2 name, and the total number of organizations in the same department, along with dense ranks partitioned by department long name ordered by department long name. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ORDER BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND f.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS total_orgs_in_department FROM inner_cte;

question: For each degree-granting department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (with more than 0 total units), along with the department's full name and the number of such subjects per department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, subj_count.subject_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ( SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s2 ON d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) subj_count ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_count.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For students whose department is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' (Course 6), show their MIT ID, full name, employee type, email address, department name, student year, and assign row numbers within each employee type group ordered by MIT ID. Additionally, only include those whose employee type is 'Student'. For each such student, also show the total number of students in 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' (Course 6). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.MIT_ID, t0.FULL_NAME, t0.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.EMPLOYEE_TYPE ORDER BY t0.MIT_ID) AS window_column FROM SE_PERSON t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.FULL_NAME = t1.FULL_NAME WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t0.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT i.MIT_ID, i.FULL_NAME, i.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, i.EMAIL_ADDRESS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.STUDENT_YEAR, i.window_column, s.total_students FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_students FROM SE_PERSON t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.FULL_NAME = t1.FULL_NAME WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t0.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) s ON 1=1;

question: For rooms with an area greater than 100 and an access level of 1, in the Stata building, show the building room identifier, the room's area, the organization name, the building number, and the building's postal code, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the building number from the building address, excluding rooms belonging to the department of facilities. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fr.BUILDING_ROOM, fr.AREA, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fba.BUILDING_NUMBER FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 100 AND fr.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND fba.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32' AND fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'DP OF FACILITIES' ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.POSTAL_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS row_num_window FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER = fba.BUILDING_NUMBER ORDER BY inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER;

question: List the department code, department name, school name, subject code, subject code description, and the total number of unique courses and total units for each degree-granting department with a department budget code above 100000, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.num_unique_courses, ic.total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each floor in the Fairchild Building, provide the floor number, the building's long name, and calculate the range and variance of the area of rooms located on that floor, considering only rooms with an access level of 1 or 2, and only include floors in academic buildings. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, fr.AREA FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '36' ) SELECT f.FLOOR, i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(i.AREA) - MIN(i.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(i.AREA) AS area_variance FROM inner_cte i JOIN FCLT_FLOOR f ON i.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY GROUP BY f.FLOOR, i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG

question: For each department (excluding Political Science), list the department name, the number of graduate students, and the number of unique graduate-level courses offered by that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS graduate_student_count, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.graduate_student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) AS num_graduate_courses FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.graduate_student_count ORDER BY inner_cte.graduate_student_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each subject offered by degree-granting departments with a non-null subject code description in the Mathematics department (Course 18), list the subject title, total units, department name, and school name, along with the dense rank over the department code ordered by department code. Additionally, include the subject code and subject code description for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each subject offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the number of enrolled students, the subject title, the academic year, the term code, and the dense rank over the offering department code (ordered by the offering department code), but only for terms where the number of enrolled students is greater than 0, the term status indicator is 'P', and the course has materials. Additionally, only include results for subjects where the number of enrolled students is above the average number of enrolled students for Chemistry subjects in the same academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t1.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) SELECT ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) avg_cte ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = avg_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_cte.avg_enrolled

question: For each academic year and department, what is the average, minimum, and maximum of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term, have more than 0 total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Also, for each such group, what is the deviation of the average total units from the overall average total units for all such Mathematics subjects in the current term? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, (AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) - overall.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) overall GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, overall.avg_total_units ORDER BY deviation_from_overall_avg DESC;

question: For all subjects offered in the academic year 2024 by the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject title, term description, and the rank of each subject within its term description group ordered by subject code, but only include those terms where at least 3 Mathematics subjects are offered in 2024. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), TermCounts AS ( SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TermCounts tc ON ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION = tc.TERM_DESCRIPTION;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for all degree-granting courses with non-null total units, and also show the difference between each course's total units and the department's average total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_variance, (ic.TOTAL_UNITS - ds.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic JOIN dept_stats ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deviation_from_avg DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects that are offered this year, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department), as well as the school name and the department phone number. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each organization, provide the organization name, the average number of supervisees per supervisor for all supervisors in that organization who have at least one supervisee, and the deviation of this average from the overall average number of supervisees per supervisor across all organizations (excluding organizations named 'ADMISSIONS' and 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST'). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST' AND ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES >= 1 GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.avg_supervisees, (inner_cte.avg_supervisees - overall.avg_all_supervisees) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_all_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST' AND ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES >= 1 ) overall;

question: Among all departments, which are the top 5 departments with the highest average office phone number among graduate students (student year 'G') who have a non-null office phone number? For each of these departments, show the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of office phone numbers, and the full name and office phone number of the graduate student in that department with the highest office phone number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_office_phone, icte.stddev_office_phone, msd.FULL_NAME AS Top_Student, msd.OFFICE_PHONE AS Top_Office_Phone FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.FULL_NAME, msd.OFFICE_PHONE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL ) msd ON icte.DEPARTMENT = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE = ( SELECT MAX(msd2.OFFICE_PHONE) FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd2 WHERE msd2.DEPARTMENT = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND msd2.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY icte.avg_office_phone DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that are printed in the bulletin and belong to the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject title, department name, total units, and the difference between the total units of each subject and the average total units for Mathematics subjects in 2022. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , avg_units AS ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TOTAL_UNITS, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg_units FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_units a;

question: For each subject offered by the library in the term "2014FA" with more than 5 enrolled students and offered by the Mathematics department, show the subject ID, subject title, the term description, the department name from the course catalog, and the running sum of enrolled students within each offer department code group ordered by subject ID, but only include those subjects where the total units for the subject (from the course catalog) is at least 9. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.running_sum_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = cso2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 9;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the minimum, maximum, and average number of TIP materials per subject offered in that year (for subjects offered in the fall term, with at least one TIP material, and in the Mathematics department), and what is the deviation of each year's average from the overall average number of TIP materials per subject across all such years? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH tip_counts AS ( SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cca JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON cca.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND cca.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID ), per_year_stats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS min_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) AS max_tip_materials, AVG(tc.num_tip_materials) AS avg_tip_materials FROM tip_counts tc JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tc.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, min_tip_materials, max_tip_materials, avg_tip_materials FROM per_year_stats ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.min_tip_materials, i.max_tip_materials, i.avg_tip_materials, (i.avg_tip_materials - (SELECT AVG(avg_tip_materials) FROM inner_cte)) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte i ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For the top 5 departments with the highest average total units per subject (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with more than zero total units), display each department's name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department, and the subject with the highest total units in that department along with its total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) , dept_avg_units AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , top5_depts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM dept_avg_units ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 5 ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT ic.DEPT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte JOIN top5_depts t5 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t5.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) ic GROUP BY ic.DEPT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , max_subjects AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte JOIN top5_depts t5 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t5.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) ic WHERE ic.rn = 1 ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, ms.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, ms.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM dept_stats ds JOIN max_subjects ms ON ds.DEPT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the department name, each subject ID, subject title, and the total number of subject enrollments for subjects offered in the current term, only including those subjects where the total number of enrollments is greater than 10. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ) SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p ON t.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE JOIN inner_cte ic ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10;

question: Show the building name, building key, and the total area of all rooms in the Stata building (building 32), but only if the total area of rooms is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total room area across all MIT buildings, and also include the total assignable area from all floors in that building. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH building_room_areas AS ( SELECT fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(total_room_area) AS mean_area, STDDEV(total_room_area) AS stddev_area FROM building_room_areas ) SELECT bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bra.total_room_area FROM building_room_areas bra JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY CROSS JOIN stats WHERE bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND bra.total_room_area > stats.mean_area + stats.stddev_area ) SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, inner_cte.total_room_area, COALESCE(SUM(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA),0) AS total_assignable_area FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY LEFT JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, inner_cte.total_room_area

question: For each department, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student and departments that grant degrees), and also include the full department name from the SIS_DEPARTMENT table, but only for the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_range, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), considering only years with more than five activities, and what is the corresponding academic year description, along with the department phone number and the school name? sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON isd.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.stddev_max_enrollment, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each academic year, which subject from the Mathematics department offered in the fall term had the highest number of enrolled students, and by how much did this enrollment exceed the average enrollment for Mathematics fall subjects that year? Please show the academic year, subject id, subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the deviation from the average. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_TITLE, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , avg_enrollment_per_year AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) , max_enrollment_per_year AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - a.avg_enrollment) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN max_enrollment_per_year m ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = m.max_enrollment JOIN avg_enrollment_per_year a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each undergraduate course in the Mathematics department, what is the course name, the number of students enrolled, and how much this number deviates from the average number of students per undergraduate Mathematics course, considering only departments that grant degrees? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS course_student_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE ) SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.course_student_count, (ic.course_student_count - avg_stats.avg_course_student_count) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(course_student_count) AS avg_course_student_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_stats ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY deviation_from_avg DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and, for each school, the number of such subjects offered in that school. question: For rooms in the Stata building (building 32) in buildings with an access level of 2, show the room key, building key, floor, major use description, area, and the difference between the room's area and the average area of all rooms on the same floor, but exclude rooms whose major use description includes 'STORAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fr.FLOOR, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, fr.AREA FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR WHERE fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' ) SELECT ic.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.FLOOR, ic.MAJOR_USE_DESC, ic.AREA, (ic.AREA - avg_floor_area.avg_area) AS area_deviation_from_floor_avg FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT FLOOR, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FLOOR ) avg_floor_area ON ic.FLOOR = avg_floor_area.FLOOR ORDER BY ic.FLOOR, ic.AREA;

question: For each building in the city of CAMBRIDGE that is used as a residence, what is the maximum assignable area among its floors, the building's name, and the total number of rooms in the building? Exclude the Stata building from the results. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS MAX_ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.MAX_ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY;

question: For each academic term in 2022, list the term code, term description, the number of Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term with at least 3 lecture units, the total lecture units for those subjects, and the instructor who teaches the most such subjects in that term, along with the count of subjects they teach. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(cso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ata.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.num_subjects_offered, icte.total_lecture_units, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS Top_Instructor, t1.Subject_Count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ata.TERM_CODE, cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS Subject_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ata.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.TERM_CODE, cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME ) t1 ON icte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE AND t1.Subject_Count = ( SELECT MAX(t2.Subject_Count) FROM ( SELECT ata2.TERM_CODE, cso2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cso2.SUBJECT_ID) AS Subject_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso2 ON ata2.TERM_CODE = cso2.TERM_CODE WHERE ata2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND cso2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso2.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3 AND cso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND cso2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata2.TERM_CODE, cso2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME ) t2 WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE ) ORDER BY icte.TERM_CODE;

question: For each department, what is the department name, the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student, have course materials with a material status of 'RQ', and are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department? Additionally, provide a grand total variance for all such courses across these departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology');

question: For each department hierarchy level 2 that is not "Political Science", what is the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for organizations in that hierarchy level, excluding organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'? Additionally, for each department hierarchy level 3 within those level 2s, show the department hierarchy level 2 name, department hierarchy level 3 name, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), only for hierarchy levels where the average organization number is greater than zero. Also, for each department hierarchy level 2, include a grand total for all its organizations in the format of (department hierarchy level 2, null, total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME AS department_hierarchy_level_2, mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS department_hierarchy_level_3, fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON mdh.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON hou.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME <> 'Political Science' ) , CoeffVarByLevel AS ( SELECT department_hierarchy_level_2, department_hierarchy_level_3, STDDEV_SAMP(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) / NULLIF(AVG(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER),0) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY department_hierarchy_level_2, department_hierarchy_level_3 WITH ROLLUP HAVING AVG(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) > 0 ) SELECT department_hierarchy_level_2, department_hierarchy_level_3, coefficient_of_variation FROM CoeffVarByLevel ORDER BY department_hierarchy_level_2, department_hierarchy_level_3

question: For each department that grants degrees, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units offered per subject in that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), but only include departments where the average total units per subject is greater than the overall average total units per subject across all degree-granting departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM dept_stats WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM inner_cte ) ;

question: For each department (excluding Chemistry), what is the department name, the variance of the number of enrolled students in degree-granting courses offered by that department during the term '2014FA', and the total number of such courses per department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, course_counts.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT LSO.COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS course_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = course_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For building addresses in the city of CAMBRIDGE that are used as a residence, show the building number from the address, the address purpose, the city, the postal code, the building name, the building type, the building use, the building's gross area, the fiscal period from the building history, the number of rooms from the building history, and the minimum assignable area from the building history over each building key group, but only for those buildings whose gross area is greater than the average gross area of all resident buildings in CAMBRIDGE (excluding buildings named "Ashdown"), ordered by building key. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fba.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, fba.CITY, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_USE, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, MIN(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS MIN_ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' ) , avg_area_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS avg_gross_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' ) SELECT i.BUILDING_NUMBER, i.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, i.CITY, i.POSTAL_CODE, i.BUILDING_NAME, i.BUILDING_TYPE, i.BUILDING_USE, i.EXT_GROSS_AREA, i.FISCAL_PERIOD, i.NUM_OF_ROOMS, i.MIN_ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_area_cte a WHERE i.EXT_GROSS_AREA > a.avg_gross_area ORDER BY i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY;

question: For each building type at MIT (excluding buildings named "Ashdown House"), what is the building type name, and for each building of that type, what is the building name and the number of rooms, for buildings whose number of rooms exceeds the average number of rooms for their building type? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, VARIANCE(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_variance, STDDEV(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL OR fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE') GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE ORDER BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE ), avg_rooms_per_type AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE, AVG(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_num_of_rooms FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL OR fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE') GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE ) SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, fb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name, fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE JOIN avg_rooms_per_type art ON fb.BUILDING_TYPE = art.BUILDING_TYPE WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL OR fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE') AND fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > art.avg_num_of_rooms ORDER BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_NAME

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects in that year (considering only subjects with more than zero total units, where the term status indicator is 'P', and the subject is offered by the Mathematics department), and for each academic year, what is the geometric mean of the total units for subjects in that year that have at least one associated textbook (i.e., at least one record in TIP_DETAIL for that subject and term)? For each academic year, include a grand total for all subjects (regardless of textbook association) in the format of (academic year, academic year description, null, geometric mean). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.TERM_CODE, ss.SUBJECT_ID, EXP(AVG(LOG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.TERM_CODE, ss.SUBJECT_ID ), SubjectTextbook AS ( SELECT DISTINCT td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_DETAIL td ), SubjectWithTextbook AS ( SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, 'Has Textbook' AS subject_textbook_status, ic.geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SubjectTextbook st ON ic.TERM_CODE = st.TERM_CODE AND ic.SUBJECT_ID = st.SUBJECT_ID ), SubjectWithoutTextbook AS ( SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, 'No Textbook' AS subject_textbook_status, ic.geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SubjectTextbook st ON ic.TERM_CODE = st.TERM_CODE AND ic.SUBJECT_ID = st.SUBJECT_ID WHERE st.TERM_CODE IS NULL ), AllSubjects AS ( SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS subject_textbook_status, ic.geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte ic ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subject_textbook_status, EXP(AVG(LOG(geometric_mean_total_units))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ( SELECT * FROM SubjectWithTextbook UNION ALL SELECT * FROM SubjectWithoutTextbook UNION ALL SELECT * FROM AllSubjects ) t GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subject_textbook_status WITH ROLLUP HAVING ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL AND ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, subject_textbook_status

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects that have at least one associated course material and are offered by the Biology department (Course 7), and also include the total number of such subjects offered in that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name and the total number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one reserved library material and are offered in the term '2009SP', but only include departments where the total number of enrolled students is greater than the average total enrolled students across all departments in such courses, and restrict the results to the Chemistry and Biology departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.total_enrolled FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) AS avg_enrolled FROM ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) x ) a ON i.total_enrolled > a.avg_enrolled;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the range and variance of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are marked as the current term and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Additionally, for each academic year, show the total number of Mathematics subjects offered in current terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_math_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE AND ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.units_range DESC;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the number of Mathematics (Course 18) subjects offered that year, and the deviation of this count from the average number of Mathematics subjects offered per academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.num_subjects, (inner_cte.num_subjects - avg_counts.avg_num_subjects) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(num_subjects) AS avg_num_subjects FROM inner_cte ) avg_counts ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the 2021FA or 2022FA term, and the corresponding school name. Only include departments where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_enrolled, d.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For students whose employee type is 'Student', who are in department 6 (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science), and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their MIT ID, full name, department name, student year, and whether their MIT ID is above the average MIT ID for their student year group ('ABOVE_AVERAGE'), below it ('BELOW_AVERAGE'), or average (otherwise). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) , avg_mit_id_per_year AS ( SELECT STUDENT_YEAR, AVG(MIT_ID) AS avg_mit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT i.MIT_ID, i.FULL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.STUDENT_YEAR, CASE WHEN i.MIT_ID > a.avg_mit_id THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.MIT_ID < a.avg_mit_id THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS mit_id_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_mit_id_per_year a ON i.STUDENT_YEAR = a.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY i.STUDENT_YEAR, i.MIT_ID;

question: For each academic year, what is the minimum academic year, the average total units for Political Science courses, and whether the average total units is 'HIGH_LOAD' (at least 8), 'LOW_LOAD' (at most 3), or 'MEDIUM_LOAD' (otherwise), considering only academic years between 2000 and 2020 or total units at least 6, and total units between 1 and 12, and the department is Political Science? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MIN(ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR ss.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.min_academic_year, inner_cte.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_total_units >= 8 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN inner_cte.avg_total_units <= 3 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'MEDIUM_LOAD' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For all subjects offered in the academic year 2022 by the Mathematics department that have at least one associated TIP material, show the subject ID, subject title, term code, term description, and the highest rank that any subject achieved within its term (ordered by subject ID). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.TERM_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(window_column) AS highest_rank_in_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION;

question: For each building at MIT that is used as a residence, list the building key, the total assignable area from building history records, and the number of history records for that building, but only include buildings whose total assignable area in history is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total assignable area across all buildings. For each building, also include a grand total row for the total assignable area and total number of history records across all such buildings. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH stats AS ( SELECT AVG(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS mean_area, STDDEV(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ), res_buildings AS ( SELECT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area, COUNT(*) AS num_history_records FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT rb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, rb.total_assignable_area, rb.num_history_records FROM res_buildings rb CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE rb.total_assignable_area > s.mean_area + s.stddev_area ) SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, total_assignable_area, num_history_records FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(total_assignable_area) AS total_assignable_area, SUM(num_history_records) AS num_history_records FROM inner_cte ;

question: For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 0, and the department is either Chemistry or Biology, provide the count of subjects, the minimum start date of the term, and indicate whether the subject count is above, below, or within 10% of the average subject count for that department across all academic years. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT department, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY department ) SELECT i.department, i.academic_year, i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'WITHIN_10_PERCENT' END AS subject_count_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.department = d.department ORDER BY i.department, i.academic_year;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, at.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.num_unique_subjects, inner_cte.min_total_units, MAX(at.TERM_END_DATE) AS latest_term_end_date FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.num_unique_subjects, inner_cte.min_total_units

question: For each department, what is the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and the school name, considering only departments that offer more than five subjects, are degree granting, and specifically include the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
