question: For each course offered by a degree-granting department in the School of Engineering (excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department), what is the course key, course name, department name, the number of catalog subjects, the total units for those subjects, and only include those courses where the total units for those subjects is greater than the average total units for all such courses in the 2007 academic year? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2007' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, COURSE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE total_units > (SELECT AVG(total_units) FROM inner_cte);

question: For each department in the School of Engineering (excluding the Political Science department), provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects during the 2019FA term, and the subject with the highest enrollment in each department, along with its subject title and enrollment count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.total_enrollment, tso.SUBJECT_ID AS highest_enrolled_subject_id, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS highest_enrolled_subject_title, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS highest_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE <> '17' ) tso ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND tso.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.total_enrollment DESC;

question: For buildings in the WEST campus sector with an access level code of 2 that are academic buildings (excluding those used as a residence), what is the minimum area of any room and the total number of rooms in those buildings, along with the full building name and the city where each building is located? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(fr.AREA) AS min_room_area, SUM(fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS total_num_of_rooms, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'WEST' AND fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = 2 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE <> 'RESIDENT' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT i.min_room_area, i.total_num_of_rooms, fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fba.CITY FROM inner_cte i JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Political Science, Course 17) that offers at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students, show the department name, the number of unique students named "Zoe" enrolled in their offered subjects, the average number of unique students named "Zoe" per department as a benchmark, and categorize each department as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% more than the average), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. List the top 10 departments by the number of unique students named "Zoe". Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.unique_students, avg_stats.avg_unique_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN inner_cte.unique_students > avg_stats.avg_unique_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.unique_students < avg_stats.avg_unique_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(unique_students) AS avg_unique_students FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.unique_students DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of all subjects offered in that year by the Mathematics department (considering only years with more than 10 subjects), and the number of Mathematics subjects in the library reserve for that year? Also, include the term description for each academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 10 ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.stddev_total_units, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_math_subjects_in_library_reserve FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON lrm.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.stddev_total_units ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION

question: For each department, list the department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 (excluding Political Science and only including degree-granting departments), and for each department, show only those subjects whose total units are above the average total units for that department in 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE, CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(i.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, units_range DESC;

Assign row numbers within each department ordered by subject code. Only include subjects from the Mathematics department, and only include those where the responsible faculty member's name starts with 'H' (case insensitive). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE UPPER(inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) LIKE 'H%';

question: For students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their first name, last name, department name, student year, the corresponding department's full name, the administrative department name, and, for each school, the total number of such students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school name and ordered by the student's first name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT icte.FIRST_NAME, icte.LAST_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY icte.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_student_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ORDER BY icte.FIRST_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the total number of lecture units for all subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18), and how does this total compare to the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all years? For each year, also indicate whether it is a 'HIGH_PERFORMER' (total lecture units at least one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean), 'LOW_PERFORMER' (at least one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) below the mean), or 'AVERAGE' (within one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the mean). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.total_lecture_units, stats.avg_lecture_units, stats.stddev_lecture_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_lecture_units >= stats.avg_lecture_units + stats.stddev_lecture_units THEN 'HIGH_PERFORMER' WHEN inner_cte.total_lecture_units <= stats.avg_lecture_units - stats.stddev_lecture_units THEN 'LOW_PERFORMER' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS performance_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(total_lecture_units) AS avg_lecture_units, STDDEV(total_lecture_units) AS stddev_lecture_units FROM inner_cte ) stats;

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10 and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units offered, and indicate whether the minimum total units is above or below the average total units for that department and year ('ABOVE_AVERAGE' if above, 'BELOW_AVERAGE' if below, otherwise 'AVERAGE'). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), avg_units_cte AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.num_unique_subjects, i.min_total_units, a.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > a.avg_total_units THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.min_total_units < a.avg_total_units THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS min_units_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_units_cte a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each school and term, provide the term code, school name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students enrolled in subjects offered in regular terms by the Chemistry or Biology departments. Include subtotals for each school (the corresponding school field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all schools (the corresponding school field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term code if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term code and school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term_code) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, school_sort) = term_code THEN NULL ELSE term_code END AS term_code, school, avg_enrollment, enrollment_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME END AS school, CASE WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME END AS school_sort, TERM_CODE AS term_code, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY term_sort, school_sort;

question: Among all degree-granting departments, which department has the highest average number of unique subject codes per course, and what is the department name, the average, and the total number of courses considered? Show only the top department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cd.DEPARTMENT, cd.COURSE, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON cd.DEPARTMENT = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cd.DEPARTMENT, cd.COURSE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.subject_count) AS avg_subject_codes_per_course, COUNT(ic.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_subject_codes_per_course DESC LIMIT 1;

question: For each school, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments, considering only schools that have at least one degree granting department that is not the Mathematics department (Course 18)? question: For each building access level and campus sector, what is the access level name, campus sector, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of rooms in building history records for academic buildings, and only for access level and campus sector combinations with more than 5 records? sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For each school, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in the current academic term, specifically for the Political Science department (Course 17)? Additionally, for each academic year, show these statistics per school, and include a grand total for each school across all academic years in the format of (school name, null, statistics). sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), SchoolYearStats AS ( SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT sys.SCHOOL_NAME, sys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, sys.avg_total_units, sys.total_units_variance, sys.total_units_stddev FROM SchoolYearStats sys UNION ALL SELECT sys.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(sys.avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sys.avg_total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sys.avg_total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SchoolYearStats sys GROUP BY sys.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR ;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology), what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students in each student year, and the total number of unique courses offered by that department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ic.num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(ic.num_students) AS stddev_num_students, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_variance, STDDEV(SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte.cip_program_code_variance, inner_cte.cip_program_code_stddev FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.cip_program_code_variance DESC;

question: For each Mathematics department subject, list the subject ID, the minimum number of enrolled students, the average lecture units, and the total number of terms offered for each subject, for subjects where the number of enrolled students is between 2 and 10 or the academic year is at least 2020, and the term start date is between '01-JAN-20' and '31-DEC-22'. Additionally, for each subject, include a grand total row showing the overall minimum number of enrolled students, average lecture units, and total terms across all subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units, COUNT(DISTINCT c.TERM_CODE) AS total_terms FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 2 AND 10) OR (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2020) ) AND a.TERM_START_DATE BETWEEN '01-JAN-20' AND '31-DEC-22' GROUP BY c.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, min_num_enrolled_students, avg_lecture_units, total_terms FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, MIN(min_num_enrolled_students) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(avg_lecture_units) AS avg_lecture_units, SUM(total_terms) AS total_terms FROM inner_cte ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID

question: For each term description in the academic year 2024, show the term description and the highest rank achieved by any Mathematics subject (ordered by subject code) within that term. Do not return any rounded answers.

question: For each academic year and school, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units offered per academic term in that year for the Mathematics department (Course 18), along with the school name? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_per_term, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(total_units_per_term) - MIN(total_units_per_term) AS units_range, VARIANCE(total_units_per_term) AS units_variance, STDDEV(total_units_per_term) AS units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For students whose department is degree-granting, whose student year is 'G', and who are in the Political Science department, show their full name, email address, department full name, and whether their email address contains 'mit.edu' (label as 'MIT_EMAIL') or not (label as 'NON_MIT_EMAIL'). Only include students whose first name is 'Zoe'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FULL_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND t1.DEPARTMENT = '17' ) SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, CASE WHEN inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS LIKE '%mit.edu%' THEN 'MIT_EMAIL' ELSE 'NON_MIT_EMAIL' END AS email_type FROM inner_cte;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and for each Mathematics (Course 18) subject offered in that year, what is the subject id, subject title, total units, and the deviation of its total units from the average total units of Mathematics subjects in that year, considering only years with more than 5 Mathematics subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_TITLE, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , avg_units_per_year AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_units_per_year a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, deviation_from_avg DESC;

question: For each school, what is the geometric mean of the department budget codes for degree-granting departments in that school, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17), and what is the count of unique subject codes associated with those departments? sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code) AS school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_code_count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department whose code is '18' (Mathematics), and for subjects offered by that department in the term 2019FA, what is the department name, the variance of the number of enrolled students in those subjects, and the number of subjects offered, restricted to departments that offered at least 5 subjects in that term? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_num_enrolled_students, COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_num_enrolled_students HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) >= 5;

question: For each department that grants degrees, what is the department's full name, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), and whether the department is a 'HIGH_VARIANCE' department (variance at least 50), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (variance less than 10), or 'MEDIUM_VARIANCE' otherwise? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_range, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance >= 50 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance < 10 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte;

question: For each room in the Stata building with area greater than 50 and access level equal to 1, excluding rooms assigned to the department of facilities, show the room key, area, organization name, building name, and the dense rank of each room within its building, and also include the building's total assignable area. Order the results by building key and room key. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.AREA, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fb.BUILDING_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_dense_rank, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND fr.AREA > 50 AND fr.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'DP OF FACILITIES' ) SELECT ic.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, ic.AREA, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.room_dense_rank, fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.FCLT_ROOM_KEY;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Mathematics department), provide the department name, the average and variance of the ASCII values of its subject codes' course numbers, but only include those departments where the average ASCII value is greater than the overall average ASCII value across all degree-granting departments (excluding Mathematics). sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_course_number_ascii, var_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_course_number_ascii > ( SELECT AVG(avg_course_number_ascii) FROM inner_cte ) ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC;

question: From the top 5 departments with the highest average total units for letter graded subjects offered this year, display each department's name, average total units, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the subject with the highest total units in that department, along with its subject title and total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , subject_ranks AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, ic.SUBJECT_CODE) AS rn FROM inner_cte ic ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, sr.SUBJECT_CODE AS top_subject_code, sr.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, sr.TOTAL_UNITS AS top_subject_total_units FROM dept_stats ds LEFT JOIN subject_ranks sr ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sr.rn = 1 ORDER BY ds.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry), what is the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, and only include those departments where the average number of enrolled students is greater than the overall average across all subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrolled_students, stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrolled_students > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED )

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in Mathematics (Course 18) courses that are offered in the current term, have more than zero enrolled students, and have available course materials. Additionally, for each academic year, indicate whether the enrolled_range is at least 50% greater than the enrolled_variance ('HIGH_SPREAD'), at least 50% less than the enrolled_variance ('LOW_SPREAD'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_SPREAD'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range > inner_cte.enrolled_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_SPREAD' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range < inner_cte.enrolled_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_SPREAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE_SPREAD' END AS spread_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each DLC whose name contains 'Office' and is not the biology department, what is the DLC key, DLC name, the number of unique organizations, the total number of assignable organizations, and whether the DLC is 'LARGE' (more than 5 assignable organizations), 'SMALL' (less than 3 assignable organizations), or 'MEDIUM' (otherwise)? Only include DLCs with at least one assignable organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assignable_organization_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.DLC_NAME LIKE '%Office%' AND LOWER(o.DLC_NAME) != LOWER('Biology') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.organization_count, inner_cte.assignable_organization_count, CASE WHEN inner_cte.assignable_organization_count > 5 THEN 'LARGE' WHEN inner_cte.assignable_organization_count < 3 THEN 'SMALL' ELSE 'MEDIUM' END AS dlc_size_category FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.assignable_organization_count >= 1;

question: For each degree-granting department in the School of Engineering (excluding the Department of Management, Course 15), what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in the 2021FA term, what is the title of the subject with that maximum enrollment, and what is the full name of the department? question: For each department and school, provide the department name, school name, and calculate the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated material record, but only include courses from the Chemistry department (Course 5). sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each school, list its name, the number of degree-granting departments (excluding the Biology department), and for each department in the school, provide the department name along with the average, range, and variance of the total units for letter graded subjects offered in the 2022 academic year. For each school, include a grand total row for all its departments in the format of (school name, null, total departments, null, null, null). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptCounts AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_departments FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.num_departments, ic.avg_total_units, ic.range_total_units, ic.var_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DeptCounts dc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = dc.SCHOOL_NAME UNION ALL SELECT dc.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL, dc.num_departments, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM DeptCounts dc ) SELECT * FROM RollupResults ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics), what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than 0), and what is the deviation of each course's total units from the department's average total units? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, (ic.TOTAL_UNITS - ds.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic JOIN dept_stats ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds.total_units_variance DESC, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TOTAL_UNITS;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and the corresponding school name and department code, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting, but exclude the departments of Mathematics and Chemistry. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects with more than zero total units and offered by the Mathematics department), and also include the average number of enrolled students in those subjects for each year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each building, what is the building name and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the assignable area across its historical records, considering only buildings with more than 3 historical records, where the building type is 'ACADEMIC', and excluding the Brown Building, and only include those buildings where the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of assignable area is greater than the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such buildings? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.COST_CENTER_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.COST_CENTER_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME <> 'BROWN BUILDING' GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ) SELECT BUILDING_NAME, assignable_area_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE assignable_area_stddev > (SELECT AVG(assignable_area_stddev) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY assignable_area_stddev DESC;

question: For each organization that belongs to departments under the 'Provost Area' in the department hierarchy (excluding organizations '138' and '250' and only including assignable organizations), provide the organization ID, organization name, the minimum organization level among all such organizations, and the total number of assignable organizations in this group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS min_org_level, SUM(f.ASSIGNABLE) AS total_assignable FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') ) SELECT f.ORGANIZATION_ID, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cte.min_org_level, cte.total_assignable FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN inner_cte cte ON 1=1 WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250');

question: For each school, list the top 5 degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science, Course 17) by the number of subjects they offered in the 2022 academic year, showing the school name, department name, and subject count. Also, for each school, include a grand total of subjects offered by all its degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science) in 2022, with the department name as null and the total subject count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn <= 5 UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each academic year after 2000, what is the academic year description, and what are the highest and lowest total units of subjects offered in that year by the Mathematics department (Course 18), considering only subjects with more than 0 total units? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR > 2000 ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department offering a course, what is the department name, the geometric mean of the total units for courses that have at least one enrolled student, a non-null ISBN in their course materials, and are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department, and whether the geometric mean is at least 10% higher than the overall average geometric mean (label as 'HIGH_GEOMEAN'), at least 10% lower (label as 'LOW_GEOMEAN'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.ISBN IS NOT NULL AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units, overall.avg_geomean, CASE WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units > overall.avg_geomean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_GEOMEAN' WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units < overall.avg_geomean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_GEOMEAN' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS geomean_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_total_units) AS avg_geomean FROM inner_cte ) overall ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Biology department), provide the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, and only include those departments where the average number of enrolled students is greater than the overall average number of enrolled students across all subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrolled_students, var_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrolled_students > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED );

question: For each department and school, provide the department name, school name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Political Science department. Also, include the department phone number. Sort the results by school name and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering, what is the highest student office phone number, the full name of the student with that phone number, and the department's full name and budget code, considering only departments that grant degrees, where the highest office phone number is greater than 1000000000, and excluding the Political Science department (Course 17)? Do not repeat the department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS MAX_OFFICE_PHONE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE > 1000000000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, inner_cte.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE, msd.FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE = inner_cte.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each building in Cambridge, MA, show the building key, building name, building type, the number of historical records, the total assignable area across all historical records, and the average number of rooms per historical record, considering only buildings with more than 1 room, with a non-null building name, and that are academic buildings. Additionally, only include buildings that are not the Stata building (building key 32). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE, COUNT(h.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS hist_record_count, SUM(h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE a.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND a.STATE = 'MA' AND b.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 1 AND b.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> 32 GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE ) SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.BUILDING_TYPE, ic.hist_record_count, ic.total_assignable_area, AVG(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_hist_num_of_rooms FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.BUILDING_TYPE, ic.hist_record_count, ic.total_assignable_area;

question: For each organization, what is the geometric mean of the old department codes for all associated HR organization units where the old department code is greater than zero, excluding organizations '138' and '250', and only for organizations that are not 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST'? Also, for each result, show the corresponding HR organization unit title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean DESC;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree-granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, the running sum of department budget codes within each school (ordered by department code), and whether the department's budget code is above average, below average, or average compared to other Mathematics departments in the same school. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.SCHOOL_CODE, sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, SUM(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ssc.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , avg_budget AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_CODE, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SCHOOL_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.running_sum_dept_budget_code, CASE WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > a.avg_budget_code THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE < a.avg_budget_code THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_budget a ON i.SCHOOL_CODE = a.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are marked as current in the term parameter table, but only for subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Additionally, for each academic year, indicate whether the maximum total units for a Mathematics subject in that year is at least 20% greater than the average total units for Mathematics subjects in that year ('HIGH_UNIT_YEAR'), at least 20% less than the average ('LOW_UNIT_YEAR'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_UNIT_YEAR'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.max_units > inner_cte.avg_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT_YEAR' WHEN inner_cte.max_units < inner_cte.avg_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_UNIT_YEAR' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT_YEAR' END AS unit_year_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.units_range DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.record_count_variance, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ic.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ic.record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department), and include the department phone number for Mathematics. Sort the results by units range in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.units_range DESC;

question: Show the department names, subject codes, subject code descriptions, undergraduate level, the total number of undergraduate courses per department, and the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in undergraduate subjects, considering only departments that are degree granting and only including the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.COURSE_LEVEL AS undergraduate_level, Total_Courses.Total_Undergrad_Courses, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Undergrad_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN inner_cte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For the top 3 degree-granting departments (excluding Management) that offer the most distinct courses, what are their department codes, department names, and the corresponding administrative department names? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, num_distinct_courses FROM inner_cte ORDER BY num_distinct_courses DESC LIMIT 3;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled, (MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS)) AS max_minus_avg FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY max_minus_avg DESC;

question: For each department that grants degrees and whose name is 'Mathematics', what is the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers, across all academic terms, considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(coefficient_of_variation) AS highest_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic term that is marked as the current term and is in the Mathematics department (Course 18), list the term code, term description, academic year, the number of subjects offered, the total subject enrollment number for that term, and the deviation of the total subject enrollment from the average total subject enrollment for all current terms in the Mathematics department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), avg_enrollment_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_total_enrollment FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.TERM_CODE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.total_enrollment, (i.total_enrollment - a.avg_total_enrollment) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment_cte a;

question: For each academic term parameter, provide the term description and, for each Mathematics subject offered this year in the corresponding effective term, list the subject number, subject title, and total units. Additionally, for each term, include a grand total row showing the average and variance of total units for all such subjects in that term (with nulls for subject number and title). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_CODE AS academic_term_parameter, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT academic_term_parameter, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY academic_term_parameter, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING (SUBJECT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL) OR (SUBJECT_NUMBER IS NULL AND SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL) ORDER BY academic_term_parameter, SUBJECT_NUMBER

question: For each department in the academic term with the term code '2019FA', list the department name, the total number of subjects in that department, and the average total units for its subjects. For each department, also include a grand total for all departments in the format of (null, total subjects, average total units). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), DepartmentStats AS ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects, AVG(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_subjects, ds.avg_total_units FROM DepartmentStats ds UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ds.total_subjects) AS total_subjects, AVG(ds.avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM DepartmentStats ds ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics) that has a non-null department full name, and is associated with an administrative department, show the department name, the average, range, and variance of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, along with the administrative department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_cip_program_code, ic.range_cip_program_code, ic.var_cip_program_code, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one reserved library material with a material status of 'U', and are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_stddev, t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_stddev, t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.enrollment_stddev DESC;

question: For each subject offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) in the term '2019FA' that has course materials, provide the subject title, number of enrolled students, responsible faculty name, the department name, and indicate whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that department in that term), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, TERM_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, TERM_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND i.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE;

question: From the top 10 degree-granting courses in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table with a department code of 6 (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science), display each course's name, course description, department name, school name, the program code, program title, category code, category title, four digit code, four digit title, the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table for each category code group, and the course with the highest minimum warehouse load date in each category code group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.PROGRAM_CODE, ic.PROGRAM_TITLE, ic.CATEGORY_CODE, ic.CATEGORY_TITLE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ic.min_warehouse_load_date FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY min_warehouse_load_date DESC) as rn FROM inner_cte ) ic WHERE ic.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.CATEGORY_CODE LIMIT 10;

question: For each department, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees, courses at the graduate level, and excluding the Biology and Chemistry departments), and whether the department is a 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (variance at least 20% greater than the average variance across all such departments), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (variance at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting, but only include departments whose name is 'Political Science' (i.e., Course 17) and where the average total units is greater than 9. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '17' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > 9 ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and the average number of enrolled students in those subjects, including only departments that have more than 5 subjects offered in the 2021FA term, excluding the Chemistry and Biology departments. question: For each subject offered in the Mathematics department (Course 18) with more than 0 enrolled students, in departments that grant degrees, list the department name, subject title, number of enrolled students, school name, and the dense rank over the department code ordered by department code. Then, from these results, select only those records where the number of enrolled students is greater than the average number of enrolled students for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled;
