question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Physics department, Course 8), what is the highest number of students enrolled in any subject offered by that department in the 2022 academic year? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18), and how does each subject's total units compare to the average for that year? For each subject, show the subject title, total units, the academic year, the average total units for that year, and whether the subject is a 'HIGH_UNIT' (at least 10% greater than average), 'LOW_UNIT' (at least 10% less than average), or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_TITLE, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , year_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, y.avg_total_units, y.total_units_variance, y.total_units_stddev, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > y.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < y.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN year_stats y ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = y.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department, and the school that offered the most such subjects in that year (with the count of subjects from that school), considering only years with more than 5 subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ic.stddev_total_units) AS stddev_total_units, ic.SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Prominent_School, ic.subject_count AS School_Subject_Count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(subject_count) AS max_subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) ranked ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ranked.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.subject_count = ranked.max_subject_count WHERE ( SELECT SUM(subject_count) FROM inner_cte ic2 WHERE ic2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) > 5 GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material, and for each department also include a grand total row for all departments in the format of (null, total average, total stddev). sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, avg_enrolled_students, stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(avg_enrolled_students) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(stddev_enrolled_students) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in degree-granting courses with more than zero enrolled students, and indicate whether the department is a 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' department (average enrollment at least 10% greater than the overall average), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_avgs ) overall ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_stddev DESC;

question: For each academic year and department, provide the academic year, academic year description, department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are marked as current in the term parameter table. Also, include subtotals for each academic year (with the department field as 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all years (with the department field as 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the academic year if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by academic year and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, academic_year_desc, dept, units_range, units_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 9999 ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS academic_year_desc FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY year_sort, dept_sort;

question: For each building in the city of CAMBRIDGE that is used as a residence, what is the maximum assignable area among its floors, and what is the building's name? sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS MAX_ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.MAX_ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY;

question: For all rooms with an area greater than 400 in the Stata building, show the room key, building room, area, the subject title of the course meeting in that room that is offered by the Computer Science department, the academic year, the rank of each room within its building (ordered by room key), and the number of distinct courses offered by the Computer Science department in each room. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, RoomCourseCounts.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY ) AS RoomCourseCounts ON inner_cte.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = RoomCourseCounts.FCLT_ROOM_KEY;

question: For each department, what is the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0, and what is the highest average total units among all departments? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT *, MAX(avg_total_units) OVER () AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For buildings with a building number of 'W85' that are used as a residence, show the floor keys, their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the assignable area, and for each building, include a grand total of the number of floors in the format of (building number, null, total floors). sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, t2.BUILDING_NUMBER, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS t0 JOIN FCLT_FLOOR t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t2 ON t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t2.BUILDING_NUMBER = 'W85' AND t2.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' ), FloorCounts AS ( SELECT BUILDING_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) AS total_floors FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NUMBER ) SELECT i.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, i.BUILDING_NUMBER, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, f.BUILDING_NUMBER, f.total_floors AS window_column FROM FloorCounts f ORDER BY BUILDING_NUMBER, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY

question: For each school, which departments that grant degrees have an average total units of courses (with more than 0 total units) greater than the overall average total units of all such courses in their school? For each such department, show the school name, department name, and the department's average total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) , school_avg AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(dept_avg_total_units) AS school_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.dept_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN school_avg s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE i.dept_avg_total_units > s.school_avg_total_units ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.dept_avg_total_units DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average CIP program code for all undergraduate courses offered by that department (as the benchmark), and for each course in that department, show the course name, its CIP program code, and whether the course is a 'HIGH_CIP' (at least 10% greater than the department average), 'LOW_CIP' (at least 10% less than the department average), or 'AVERAGE'. Only include departments that are degree granting and are Mathematics (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE, c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) , dept_benchmark AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_cip_code, i.COURSE, i.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, CASE WHEN i.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > d.avg_cip_code * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_CIP' WHEN i.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE < d.avg_cip_code * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_CIP' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS cip_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_benchmark d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12 in the Mathematics department, show the department code, department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, and the deviation of each subject's total units from the average total units of all Mathematics subjects offered in 2024. Assign row numbers within each department ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), math_avg AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.window_column, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - m.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN math_avg m ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For subjects in the course catalog with a total of 12 units, offered in the fall term, and in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, total units, whether the subject is offered in the fall term, the offering department name, the subject enrollment number, the average subject enrollment number for the department as the benchmark, and whether the subject is a 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than average), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than average), or 'AVERAGE'. Also, assign row numbers within each department ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), dept_benchmark AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS benchmark FROM ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) sub GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, d.benchmark, CASE WHEN i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > d.benchmark * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER < d.benchmark * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_benchmark d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics), show the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments, along with the department's full name and school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_clearing_cost_collector, ic.clearing_cost_collector_variance, ic.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry), that has offered more than 5 subjects, what is the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered, and the most common student year among students in that department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.stddev_total_units, msd.STUDENT_YEAR AS Most_Common_Student_Year FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS year_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) msd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, provide the department's name, the school name, and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and that are also listed in the CIS course catalog, but only include departments that are Mathematics (Course 18). Also, include the department's phone number from the SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT table. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.units_range DESC;

question: From the top 10 subject codes with the highest number of graduate-level courses in the 'Political Science' department, display each subject code's description, department name, school name, the total count of such courses, and the course description of the most recently added course (by last activity date) for that subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME AS SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS COURSE_DEPT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME AS COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY scd.COURSE_LEVEL) AS course_level_dense_rank FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE WHERE ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, sc_count.Course_Count, latest_course.Latest_COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM (SELECT SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Course_Count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY Course_Count DESC LIMIT 10 ) sc_count JOIN inner_cte icte ON sc_count.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC = icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC AND sc_count.SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME = icte.SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME AND sc_count.SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME = icte.SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS Latest_COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY COURSE_LEVEL DESC, COURSE_DESCRIPTION DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COURSE_LEVEL DESC ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) latest_course ON sc_count.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC = latest_course.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC AND sc_count.SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME = latest_course.SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME AND sc_count.SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME = latest_course.SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sc_count.Course_Count DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the description of the academic year and the variance of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are regular terms, have a term status of 'Previous', and are offered by the Mathematics department, where this variance is greater than the overall variance of total units for all Mathematics subjects in regular, previous terms? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, total_units_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE total_units_variance > ( SELECT VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest total number of enrolled students in courses offered by the School of Engineering or School of Science, display each department's name, the total number of enrolled students, the school name, and the course with the highest enrollment in that department, along with the number of students enrolled in that course. Only include departments that grant degrees or the Department of Mathematics, and only consider departments where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 20. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrolled_students, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, top_course.COURSE_NUMBER AS Most_Enrolled_Course, top_course.max_enrollment AS Course_Enrollment FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.COURSE_NUMBER, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrollment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') ) top_course ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_course.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND top_course.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.total_enrolled_students DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department, what is the department code, department name, and the total number of enrolled students in all subjects offered by that department, considering only departments where the total enrollment is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total enrollment across all departments, and where the department is Mathematics (department code '18')? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) + STDDEV(total_enrollment) FROM ( SELECT SUM(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT std2 ON tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) sub ) ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrollment FROM inner_cte;

question: For each academic year, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered in that year by the Mathematics department, considering only activities that require advance sign-up and are not cancelled? Also, provide the academic year description, the department phone number, and the school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.max_enrollment_variance, ic.max_enrollment_stddev, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.max_enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name and the total number of units for courses in the "Engineering" or "Non-MIT" schools, where the total units for the department is greater than 1000, and restrict the results to departments that are not "Political Science" (Course 17). Additionally, for each such department, list the number of distinct courses offered in the most recent academic year available. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS num_courses_latest_year FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ) GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units

question: For each academic year, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in the current term by the Mathematics department (Course 18), and for each subject, show its subject title, total units, and whether its total units are 'HIGH_UNIT' (at least 10% greater than the average), 'LOW_UNIT' (at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE_UNIT'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, cte.avg_total_units, cte.total_units_variance, cte.total_units_stddev, CASE WHEN ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > cte.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ccso.TOTAL_UNITS < cte.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE JOIN inner_cte cte ON at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry), list the department name, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, the full name of the corresponding administrative department, and the total number of distinct subjects offered by that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_range, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subj_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) subj_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, provide the department code, department name, and the total number of enrolled students in all subjects offered by that department, but only for departments where the total number of enrolled students is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the average total enrolled students across all departments, and where the department is in the School of Science. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM ( SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ) ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science';

question: Among the departments that offered at least 5 subjects in 2021 (excluding Chemistry), for each such department, show the department code, department name, school name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, and the subject with the highest enrollment (including its subject title and number of enrolled students). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.num_subjects_offered, ic.total_enrolled_students, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE AS highest_enrolled_subject_title, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS highest_enrolled_subject_students FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC, s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS rn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' ) sos ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.num_subjects_offered DESC, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department in non-summer, non-current terms, and indicate whether the average total units for that year is 'HIGH_LOAD' (at least 10% greater than the overall average), 'LOW_LOAD' (at least 10% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.avg_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN icte.avg_total_units > overall.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN icte.avg_total_units < overall.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte icte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg FROM ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) sub ) overall ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the highest, lowest, and average total units for subjects offered in the 2022FA term (excluding 'Mathematics' and Course 18), and also show the number of unique subject titles offered by each department in that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT != '18' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY max_total_units DESC;

question: For each organization that belongs to departments under the 'Provost Area' in the department hierarchy (excluding organizations '138' and '250' and only including assignable organizations), provide the organization name, its organization level, whether it is a 'TOP_LEVEL' (organization level = minimum organization level among these organizations), and the total number of assignable organizations in this group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS min_org_level, SUM(f.ASSIGNABLE) AS total_assignable FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') ) SELECT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, CASE WHEN f.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = cte.min_org_level THEN 'TOP_LEVEL' ELSE 'NON_TOP_LEVEL' END AS org_level_category, cte.total_assignable FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY CROSS JOIN inner_cte cte WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250');

question: For each school, provide the school name and, for each department in that school that is degree-granting and not 'Political Science', list the department name, and calculate the average, range, and variance of the subject codes' lengths for subjects offered by that department. For each school, also include a grand total for all departments in the format of (school name, null, averages for all departments). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL ) , SubjectStats AS ( SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, LENGTH(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_length FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sc.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subject_code_length) AS avg_subject_code_length, MAX(subject_code_length) - MIN(subject_code_length) AS range_subject_code_length, VARIANCE(subject_code_length) AS var_subject_code_length FROM SubjectStats GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2007' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, inner_cte.COURSE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.total_units, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON inner_cte.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY = scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY;

question: For each building in the city of CAMBRIDGE that is used as a residence, what is the maximum assignable area among its floors, what is the building's name, and what is the total number of rooms in the building? Exclude the Stata building from the results, and only include buildings where the maximum assignable area among its floors is greater than the average assignable area of all floors in CAMBRIDGE residential buildings (excluding the Stata building). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS MAX_ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS ) SELECT BUILDING_NAME, MAX_ASSIGNABLE_AREA, NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM inner_cte WHERE MAX_ASSIGNABLE_AREA > ( SELECT AVG(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' ) ;

question: For academic buildings where the total number of rooms is greater than the average number of rooms across all academic buildings, list the building name and the total number of rooms, showing only the top 10 such buildings. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ) SELECT BUILDING_NAME, room_count FROM inner_cte WHERE room_count > ( SELECT AVG(room_count) FROM inner_cte ) ORDER BY room_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each school, provide the school name and the highest average total units for degree-granting courses offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), grouped by course level (undergraduate or graduate), considering only courses with a non-null total units value. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL ) subquery1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC;

question: For each school, what is the school name and both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students in each student year for each department in that school, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Biology department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.STUDENT_YEAR, sc.num_students FROM student_counts sc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each administrative department, give the administrative department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2024, but only include departments whose name is 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2) and where the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is greater than 0.2. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE coefficient_of_variation > 0.2;

question: For each department, give the department name and the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department across all terms, but only include departments that are not 'Biology' (Course 7). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT department_name, MAX(coefficient_of_variation) AS highest_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY department_name;

question: List the top 10 subject titles offered by the Chemistry department along with their department names, the number of course materials assigned to each, and the total number of enrolled students for each subject, for subjects that have at least one enrolled student and at least one course material record. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_course_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING num_course_materials > 0 ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.num_course_materials, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = tso.SUBJECT_TITLE AND icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.num_course_materials ORDER BY icte.num_course_materials DESC, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE LIMIT 10;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by degree-granting departments (excluding Chemistry), and the average number of enrolled students per subject for those departments that have at least 100 total enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_per_subject FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students ORDER BY inner_cte.total_enrolled_students DESC;

question: For each academic year and each department, what is the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, are not variable units, and are in departments whose names contain 'Mathematics'? For each academic year, include a grand total for all such departments in the format of (academic year, null, total statistics). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Mathematics%' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For rooms with an area greater than 100 and an access level of 1, in the Stata building, show the building room identifier, the room's area, the organization name, and the building number, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the building number from the building address, excluding rooms belonging to the department of facilities. Only include results where the building number ends with '2' and the total number of such rooms per organization is at least 3. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fr.BUILDING_ROOM, fr.AREA, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY fba.BUILDING_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS row_num_window, fba.BUILDING_NUMBER FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 100 AND fr.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND fba.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32' AND fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'DP OF FACILITIES' ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.AREA, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.BUILDING_NUMBER, ic.row_num_window FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM inner_cte WHERE BUILDING_NUMBER LIKE '%2' GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ) orgs ON ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = orgs.ORGANIZATION_NAME WHERE ic.BUILDING_NUMBER LIKE '%2'

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are marked as the current term in the term parameter table and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), and what is the total number of such Mathematics subjects per academic year? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, subj_count.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT sub.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) subj_count ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subj_count.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and the name of the corresponding administrative department (if any), restricting the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: From the top 5 Mathematics department subjects offered in the 2022 academic year with the highest maximum enrollment (where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10), display each subject's title, the maximum number of enrolled students, the term description in which this maximum occurred, and the name of the instructor most frequently responsible for the subject (along with the count of terms they taught it). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, c.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, c.SUBJECT_ID HAVING MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.max_enrollment, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, imf.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS Most_Frequent_Instructor, imf.Terms_Taught FROM ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(max_enrollment) AS max_enrollment, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_ID ) ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.SUBJECT_ID, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Terms_Taught, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t WHERE t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_ID, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME ) imf ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = imf.SUBJECT_ID AND imf.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.max_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For each department, list the department name and the highest number of course materials assigned to any subject offered by that department, considering only subjects that have at least one enrolled student and at least one course material record. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_course_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING num_course_materials > 0 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(num_course_materials) AS highest_num_course_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each department and school, what is the highest number of degree-granting undergraduate courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18), and what are the corresponding department name, school name, and the number of unique subject codes associated with those courses? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.num_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_subject_codes FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND c.SCHOOL_NAME = i.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = c.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.num_courses ORDER BY i.num_courses DESC LIMIT 1;

question: For each building, list the floor number, the number of rooms on that floor with an area greater than 500 and whose major use description does not include 'STORAGE', and the total area of such rooms. question: Among all degree-granting departments except Chemistry (Course 5), which department had the highest average total units for subjects offered in the 2008 academic year, and what is the range and variance of total units for subjects in that department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.avg_total_units = ( SELECT MAX(avg_total_units) FROM inner_cte )

question: For each academic year, what is the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that start after January 1, 2010 and are regular terms, specifically for subjects in the Mathematics department, and what is the total number of such Mathematics subjects offered per academic year? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, subject_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS subject_counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subject_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry) that offered at least one subject in the term '2016SP', display the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered per term by that department, as well as the term in which the department offered the most subjects and the corresponding number of subjects in that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_terms AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ), subjects_per_term AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ) SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, spt.TERM_CODE, spt.num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) ), ranked_terms AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.num_subjects, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.num_subjects DESC, icte.TERM_CODE) AS term_rank FROM inner_cte icte ), agg_stats AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(icte.num_subjects) - MIN(icte.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(icte.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(icte.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM inner_cte icte GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.range_num_subjects, a.variance_num_subjects, a.stddev_num_subjects, r.TERM_CODE AS term_with_most_subjects, r.num_subjects AS num_subjects_in_term FROM agg_stats a JOIN ranked_terms r ON a.DEPARTMENT_CODE = r.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND r.term_rank = 1 ORDER BY a.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each school, provide the school name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by departments in that school in the 2022 academic year, but only include schools where all departments grant degrees and exclude any school that contains the Biology department (Course 7). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.avg_units) AS school_avg_units, VARIANCE(ic.avg_units) AS school_units_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_CODE = d.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_CODE NOT IN ( SELECT SCHOOL_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE = '7' ) GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY school_units_variance DESC;

question: For each Mathematics department subject offered in the term '2019FA' that has course materials, list the subject title, number of enrolled students, responsible faculty name, the department name, and the school name. Also, include a dense rank over the department name, ordered by department name. Do not repeat the department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE) = DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest average total units for their subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), display each department's name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the school most represented among those subjects, and the count of subjects from that school. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT d_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d_stats.avg_total_units, d_stats.stddev_total_units, s_stats.Most_Prominent_School, s_stats.Subject_Count FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) d_stats LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Prominent_School, Subject_Count, @rank := IF(@current_dept = DEPARTMENT_NAME, @rank + 1, 1) AS `Rank`, @current_dept := DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ) s CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_dept := '') vars ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Subject_Count DESC ) s_stats ON d_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s_stats.`Rank` = 1 ORDER BY d_stats.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Physics department, Course 8), provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, and the average number of enrolled students for those subjects, but only include departments with more than one subject offered in 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2022%' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department with a department budget code above 100000, excluding the Political Science department, provide the department code, department name, school name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, the total number of units for all those courses, and the number of those courses that are cross-listed in the SIS_SUBJECT_CODE table (i.e., have a matching SUBJECT_CODE in SIS_SUBJECT_CODE). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.num_unique_courses, ic.total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_crosslisted_courses FROM inner_cte ic JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ccc.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.num_unique_courses, ic.total_units ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each building type and campus sector, which buildings have an assignable area greater than the average assignable area for their group, considering only buildings with more than 10 rooms, a non-null building use, and that are residential buildings, using both the current and historical building data, and only including buildings that are owned? Return the building type, campus sector, building number, and assignable area. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT BUILDING_TYPE, CAMPUS_SECTOR, BUILDING_NUMBER, ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING WHERE NUM_OF_ROOMS > 10 AND BUILDING_USE IS NOT NULL AND BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' UNION ALL SELECT BUILDING_TYPE, CAMPUS_SECTOR, BUILDING_NUMBER, ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST WHERE NUM_OF_ROOMS > 10 AND BUILDING_USE IS NOT NULL AND BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' ), group_avgs AS ( SELECT BUILDING_TYPE, CAMPUS_SECTOR, AVG(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_TYPE, CAMPUS_SECTOR ) SELECT i.BUILDING_TYPE, i.CAMPUS_SECTOR, i.BUILDING_NUMBER, i.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM inner_cte i JOIN group_avgs g ON i.BUILDING_TYPE = g.BUILDING_TYPE AND i.CAMPUS_SECTOR = g.CAMPUS_SECTOR WHERE i.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > g.avg_assignable_area;

question: For each academic building at MIT with more than 3 historical records and a nonzero assignable area, what is the building name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the assignable area across its historical records, the current assignable area, and the deviation of the current assignable area from the historical average? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, STDDEV(h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_stddev, AVG(h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ) SELECT i.BUILDING_NAME, i.assignable_area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS current_assignable_area, (b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA - i.avg_assignable_area) AS deviation_from_historical_avg FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN inner_cte i ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY i.assignable_area_stddev DESC;

question: For buildings located in the city of CAMBRIDGE with a non-zero assignable area on their floors, and that are academic buildings, show the building name, building number, floor number, assignable area, building address postal code, the total number of floors per building, and assign row numbers within each postal code group ordered by building number. Additionally, restrict the results to buildings that are Maclaurin Buildings. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_NAME, t2.BUILDING_NUMBER, t1.FLOOR, t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, t0.POSTAL_CODE, t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS t0 JOIN FCLT_FLOOR t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t2 ON t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND t2.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND t2.BUILDING_NAME = 'MACLAURIN BUILDINGS (3)' ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME, inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER, inner_cte.FLOOR, inner_cte.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, inner_cte.POSTAL_CODE, FloorCounts.Total_Floors, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.POSTAL_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.FLOOR) AS Total_Floors FROM FCLT_BUILDING t2 JOIN FCLT_FLOOR t1 ON t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) AS FloorCounts ON inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FloorCounts.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY;

question: For each city, list the city name and, for each building in that city that is used as a residence (excluding the Stata building), show the building number and its external gross area, but only include buildings whose external gross area is above the average for residential buildings in that city. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fba.CITY AS city_name, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NUMBER, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' ) , city_avg AS ( SELECT city_name, AVG(EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS avg_ext_gross_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY city_name ) SELECT i.city_name, i.BUILDING_NUMBER, i.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM inner_cte i JOIN city_avg a ON i.city_name = a.city_name WHERE i.EXT_GROSS_AREA > a.avg_ext_gross_area ORDER BY i.city_name, i.BUILDING_NUMBER ;

question: For each building address in the city of Cambridge, show the building number, address purpose, city, state, postal code, the building name, building type, building use, and the maximum number of rooms from the building history for the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by building key, but only include buildings that are academic buildings. For each building name and building type, include a grand total for all rows in the format of (building name, building type, null, total max number of rooms). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fba.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, fba.CITY, fba.STATE, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_USE, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, GREATEST( fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0) ) AS max_num_of_rooms_3rows FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'Cambridge' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, ADDRESS_PURPOSE, SUM(max_num_of_rooms_3rows) AS total_max_num_of_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, ADDRESS_PURPOSE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(max_num_of_rooms_3rows) > 0 ) SELECT rr.BUILDING_NAME, rr.BUILDING_TYPE, rr.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, rr.total_max_num_of_rooms FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.BUILDING_NAME, rr.BUILDING_TYPE, rr.ADDRESS_PURPOSE

question: For each degree-granting department in the School of Engineering (excluding the Department of Management, Course 15), what is the maximum total units of any course offered by that department in the 2008 academic year, along with the subject code, subject code description, and the graduate level of that course? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2008' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE
