question: Show the school name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by departments in that school (excluding subjects from the "Biology" department), and for each such school, list the department names and the total number of unique subjects offered by each department. Only include schools that have a department named "Political Science". Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH schools_with_ps AS ( SELECT DISTINCT scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ), subject_units AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM schools_with_ps) AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subject_units GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_subjects.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.SCHOOL_NAME = sd.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN ( SELECT sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cso2.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_subjects ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering (excluding Chemistry and only including degree-granting departments), list the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, and the number of unique subjects offered by that department, but only include departments where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled ORDER BY ic.total_enrolled DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a total number of units greater than 1, in the Political Science department, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each school name group, and for each school name, report the maximum running sum of total units among its subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER ( PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS running_sum_total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(running_sum_total_units) AS max_running_sum_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the 'Engineering' school with total units greater than 0, and only for subjects in the 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' department (Course 6), show the subject title, total units, department name, course description, and the number of subjects per offer department code, but only include offer department codes that have more than 5 such subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, dept_counts.subject_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) dept_counts ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE;

question: For each department that grants degrees and is in the School of Science, what is the department name, the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), and the total number of such subjects? Only include departments with at least 5 such subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;

question: For each building in CAMBRIDGE that is used as a residence (excluding buildings named "Ashdown"), what is the maximum number of rooms recorded in its building history for any fiscal period? Show the building number from the address, the address purpose, the city, the postal code, the building name, the building type, the building use, the building's gross area, and the maximum number of rooms from the building history, ordered by building key. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fba.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, fba.CITY, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_USE, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, MIN(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS MIN_ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' ) SELECT BUILDING_NUMBER, ADDRESS_PURPOSE, CITY, POSTAL_CODE, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, BUILDING_USE, EXT_GROSS_AREA, MAX(NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS MAX_NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NUMBER, ADDRESS_PURPOSE, CITY, POSTAL_CODE, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, BUILDING_USE, EXT_GROSS_AREA ORDER BY BUILDING_NAME;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering with a course level of 'G', offered by the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, show the course description, department name, program title, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description, but only include those courses where the program's category code is 11. question: From the top 10 schools with the highest average total units for Mathematics (Course 18) courses, display each school's name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for those courses, as well as the department in that school with the highest average total units for degree-granting departments and courses with more than 0 total units, and the average total units for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, dmax.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Top_Department, dmax.avg_total_units AS Top_Department_Avg_Units FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10 ) ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dmax ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = dmax.SCHOOL_NAME AND dmax.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.avg_total_units DESC;

question: For each city, among buildings used as residences (excluding the Stata building), what is the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the assignable area for each building (considering only buildings with a nonzero average assignable area), and for each city, which building has the highest average assignable area? Provide the city name, the building name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for that building, and the average assignable area. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fba.CITY, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area, STDDEV(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' GROUP BY fba.CITY, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING avg_assignable_area > 0 ) SELECT ic.CITY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, ic.stddev_assignable_area / ic.avg_assignable_area AS coefficient_of_variation, ic.avg_assignable_area FROM ( SELECT CITY, FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, avg_assignable_area, stddev_assignable_area, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CITY ORDER BY avg_assignable_area DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE ic.rn = 1;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects that are offered in the Fall term, have at least 1 enrolled student, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), and also show the difference between the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for each year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students, (inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students - inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students) AS avg_minus_stddev FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name and the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and where the department is degree granting, but exclude the Mathematics department (Course 18). Then, for each school, show the school name and the highest average number of enrolled students per department (as calculated previously) among its departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_enrolled_students) AS highest_avg_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each department in the "Provost Area" (excluding "Political Science"), what is the maximum organization number and the name of the associated space unit, considering only those departments where the maximum organization number is greater than 50000? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT mdh.DLC_NAME AS department, MAX(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS max_organization_number, su.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON mdh.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER > 50000 AND mdh.DLC_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY mdh.DLC_NAME, su.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT department, max_organization_number, space_unit_name FROM inner_cte WHERE max_organization_number > 50000 ORDER BY department;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in each academic year for terms that are regular terms and for subjects offered by the Mathematics department, and for each academic year, which subject had the highest total units, and what is its subject title? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, cso.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_with_max_units, cso.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.SUBJECT_ID, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON at.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) cso ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = ( SELECT MAX(cso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = cso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND cso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_range DESC;

question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding the Biology department), which offers graduate-level courses, what is the average number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, and which subjects have an enrollment above this departmental average? Please provide the department name, subject title, and the number of enrolled students for these subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For each IAP activity offered in the 2021 January term that is associated with at least one subject with more than 3 lecture units and offered by the Mathematics department, what is the maximum number of lecture units among its associated catalog subjects, along with the activity title, the term description, and the subject title of the subject with the maximum lecture units? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, MAX(CASE WHEN LECTURE_UNITS = (SELECT MAX(LECTURE_UNITS) FROM inner_cte ic2 WHERE ic2.ACTIVITY_TITLE = inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND ic2.TERM_DESCRIPTION = inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION) THEN SUBJECT_TITLE ELSE NULL END) AS subject_title_with_max_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(LECTURE_UNITS) > 3;

question: For each academic year, what is the highest total units among all subjects offered in that year from the Mathematics department, the term description for the corresponding term, and the subject short title, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 6 total units? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte.max_total_units AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6;

question: For rooms in the Stata building (building 32) in buildings with an access level of 2, show the room key, building key, floor, major use description, area, and the average area over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the floor's sort sequence and ordered by the room's area, but only include rooms whose area is greater than the average area for their floor. Exclude rooms whose major use description includes 'STORAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fr.FLOOR, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, fr.AREA, ff.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR WHERE fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' ) SELECT i.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, i.FLOOR, i.MAJOR_USE_DESC, i.AREA, AVG(i.AREA) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE ORDER BY i.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_area_window FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE, AVG(AREA) AS avg_floor_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE ) favg ON i.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE = favg.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE WHERE i.AREA > favg.avg_floor_area ORDER BY i.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE, i.AREA;

question: From the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding Biology, Course 7) with the highest average total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, display each department's name, its average and variance of total units, the subject with the highest total units in that department for 2022, and the total units of that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, s.TOTAL_UNITS AS Top_Subject_Total_Units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ) s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each subject where the responsible faculty MIT ID in the library subject offered table is 928034000 or the number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table is greater than 5, and where the offer department name in the tip subject offered table is either 'Chemistry' or 'Biology', show the subject title from the library subject offered table, the offer department name from the tip subject offered table, the term code from both tables, the number of enrolled students from both tables, the minimum number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table over each master subject ID group, and the responsible faculty name from the library subject offered table. Do not repeat the master subject ID if it is the same as the previous row. Order the results by master subject ID and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE ( lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE) = MASTER_SUBJECT_ID THEN NULL ELSE MASTER_SUBJECT_ID END AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, TIP_TERM_CODE, LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each type of space usage, provide the space usage name, the building room name, and calculate the average, range, and variance of the room square footage for all rooms with a room counter of 1 that are located in the Stata building. For each space usage, include a grand total for all rooms of that usage type in the format of (space usage, null, total statistics). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_USAGE, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_COUNTER = 1 AND sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 ) SELECT SPACE_USAGE, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, AVG(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_square_footage, MAX(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) - MIN(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS square_footage_range, VARIANCE(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS square_footage_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_USAGE, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY SPACE_USAGE, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Political Science), that has at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students, list the department name, the total count of unique subject titles, and the total number of enrolled students across all their subjects. Show only the top 10 departments by the number of unique subject titles. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

Include subtotals for each building type (the corresponding campus sector field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all building types (the corresponding campus sector field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the building type if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by building type and campus sector. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR AS campus_sector, VARIANCE(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_variance, STDDEV(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL OR fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE') GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(building_type_name) OVER (ORDER BY building_type_sort, campus_sector_sort) = building_type_name THEN NULL ELSE building_type_name END AS building_type_name, campus_sector, num_of_rooms_variance, num_of_rooms_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(building_type_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(campus_sector) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE building_type_name END AS building_type_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(building_type_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(campus_sector) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(building_type_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(campus_sector) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE campus_sector END AS campus_sector, CASE WHEN GROUPING(building_type_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(campus_sector) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE campus_sector END AS campus_sector_sort, building_type_name, VARIANCE(num_of_rooms_variance) AS num_of_rooms_variance, STDDEV(num_of_rooms_stddev) AS num_of_rooms_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY building_type_name, campus_sector WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp ORDER BY building_type_sort, campus_sector_sort;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the total number of enrolled students in courses offered by the department of Engineering or Science (or the Department of Mathematics), and indicate whether the department is a 'LARGE_DEPARTMENT' (if the total enrolled students is at least 50% greater than the average total enrolled students across these departments), a 'SMALL_DEPARTMENT' (if at least 30% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Only include departments that grant degrees. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, avg_stats.avg_total_enrolled_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_enrolled_students >= avg_stats.avg_total_enrolled_students * 1.5 THEN 'LARGE_DEPARTMENT' WHEN inner_cte.total_enrolled_students <= avg_stats.avg_total_enrolled_students * 0.7 THEN 'SMALL_DEPARTMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS department_size_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled_students) AS avg_total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats;

question: For each floor in the Stata building (building 32), what is the largest room square footage and the name of the building room with that largest square footage, for rooms loaded into the warehouse on 19-DEC-24, where the largest room square footage is greater than 100, and also provide the floor name and room name only if the floor has more than 2 rooms with square footage greater than 100? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = ( SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' ) ), RoomCounts AS ( SELECT sd.FLOOR_KEY, COUNT(*) AS ROOM_COUNT FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 GROUP BY sd.FLOOR_KEY ) SELECT icte.FLOOR_NAME, icte.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, icte.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN RoomCounts rc ON icte.FLOOR_KEY = rc.FLOOR_KEY WHERE rc.ROOM_COUNT > 2 ORDER BY icte.FLOOR_NAME;

question: For each academic building at MIT, give the building key, the total assignable area across all its historical records, and the building's long name, considering only those buildings whose total assignable area is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total assignable area for all buildings. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH total_assignable AS ( SELECT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fbh.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = fb.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(total_assignable_area) AS mean_assignable, STDDEV(total_assignable_area) AS stddev_assignable FROM total_assignable ) SELECT ta.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ta.total_assignable_area FROM total_assignable ta CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE ta.total_assignable_area > s.mean_assignable + s.stddev_assignable ) SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, inner_cte.total_assignable_area, fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ;

question: For each degree-granting department with a department budget code greater than 100000, excluding the Mathematics and Physics departments, list the department name, total clearing cost collector, and the department phone number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_clearing_cost_collector, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology, Course 7), give the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, the average total units for that department as a benchmark, and classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' if the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 10% greater than the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such departments, 'LOW_VARIABILITY' if it is at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.avg_total_units, avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in each term of that year, considering only terms that are regular terms, are not in the future, and where the subjects are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Additionally, for each term, what is the most common grade type among these Mathematics subjects and how many subjects have that grade type? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, gt.Most_Common_Grade_Type, gt.Grade_Type_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, ccso.GRADE_TYPE AS Most_Common_Grade_Type, COUNT(*) AS Grade_Type_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, ccso.GRADE_TYPE HAVING COUNT(*) = ( SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.TERM_CODE WHERE at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND at2.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE AND at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at2.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccso2.GRADE_TYPE ) sub ) ) gt ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = gt.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = gt.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND ic.TERM_CODE = gt.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.TERM_CODE;

question: For each department, list the department name, the number of graduate students named Zoe whose department is degree-granting and offers at least one course with more than 6 total units, the school name, and the department phone number. Include a subtotal row for all departments (the department field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total row (the department field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, num_zoe_grad_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS num_zoe_grad_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN inner_cte ON msd.DEPARTMENT = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT AND msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS = inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dept_sort;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that are letter graded and are in the Mathematics department, show the subject title, department name, term description, and the number of subjects per term. For each department and academic year, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (null, department name, academic year, total subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), SubjectCounts AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects FROM SubjectCounts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN TERM_DESCRIPTION IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, total_subjects FROM RollupResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION ;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mechanical Engineering), provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments, and also include the total number of administrative departments linked to each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '2' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) - MIN(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev, COUNT(*) AS num_admin_departments FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, have a non-null department name, are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), and have at least one required textbook (TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ')? Also, include the number of such subjects per academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects, AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE) GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each school, provide the school name, the average total units for all courses offered by that school, the average total units for all courses in the same department as each course, and classify each course as 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' if its total units are at least 10% greater than the department average, 'BELOW_AVERAGE' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Only include schools that do not offer courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), schools_with_math AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), department_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_units FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG WHERE TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS school_avg_units, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, da.dept_avg_units, CASE WHEN ic.TOTAL_UNITS > da.dept_avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN ic.TOTAL_UNITS < da.dept_avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN schools_with_math swm ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = swm.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN department_avg da ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = da.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE swm.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, da.dept_avg_units, ic.TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each school, show the school name and the highest dense rank of administrative department names among all degree-granting graduate-level courses offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(admin_dept_dense_rank) AS highest_admin_dept_dense_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each department offering a course, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student, have a material status of 'RQ', are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department, and also have a corresponding library reserve material with a material status of 'U'? sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ic.department, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.department = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrd.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ic.department, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students

question: From the top 10 schools with the highest average total units for subjects offered by departments in that school (considering only subjects that are offered this year, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department), display each school's name, average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, as well as the department within that school with the highest number of such subjects and the count of those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ict.SCHOOL_NAME, ict.avg_total_units, ict.var_total_units, ict.stddev_total_units, ict.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, dept_stats.Subject_Count FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, avg_total_units, var_total_units, stddev_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10 ) ict LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON ict.SCHOOL_NAME = dept_stats.SCHOOL_NAME AND ict.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ict.avg_total_units DESC;

question: For each organization and HR department, excluding organizations with IDs '138' and '250', provide the organization name, HR department name, the average and variance of the HR department IDs for all associated HR org units that are not part of the Cambridge-MIT Institute. Include subtotals for each organization (the corresponding HR department name is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all organizations (the corresponding HR department name is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the organization name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by organization name and HR department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID IS NOT NULL AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(organization_name) OVER (ORDER BY org_sort, dept_sort) = organization_name THEN NULL ELSE organization_name END AS organization_name, hr_department_name, avg_department_id, department_id_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(organization_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(hr_department_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE organization_name END AS org_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(organization_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(hr_department_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(organization_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(hr_department_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE hr_department_name END AS hr_department_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(organization_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(hr_department_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE hr_department_name END AS dept_sort, organization_name, AVG(HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS avg_department_id, VARIANCE(HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS department_id_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY organization_name, hr_department_name WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY org_sort, dept_sort;

question: For the top 5 academic buildings at MIT with the highest number of floors that have at least one room, provide each building's long name, the total number of such floors, the range and variance of the assignable area of these floors, and the floor with the largest assignable area along with its assignable area. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH floors_with_rooms AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_FLOOR ff JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ff.FLOOR = fr.FLOOR ), academic_buildings AS ( SELECT DISTINCT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT' ) SELECT ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fwr.FLOOR, fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM academic_buildings ab JOIN floors_with_rooms fwr ON ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fwr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ), floor_stats AS ( SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, COUNT(*) AS num_floors, MAX(ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) - MIN(ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_range, VARIANCE(ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_variance FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ), max_floor AS ( SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.FLOOR AS max_assignable_area_floor, ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS max_assignable_area FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS max_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) m ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = m.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA = m.max_area ) SELECT fs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fs.num_floors, fs.assignable_area_range, fs.assignable_area_variance, mf.max_assignable_area_floor, mf.max_assignable_area FROM floor_stats fs LEFT JOIN max_floor mf ON fs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = mf.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fs.num_floors DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For each administrative department and academic year, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department in that year, considering only departments that grant degrees, courses with total units greater than 0, and excluding the Mechanical Engineering department (Course 2)? Also, include the school name and department phone number for each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: From the top 10 schools with the highest average CIP program codes for degree-granting courses offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), display each school's name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the CIP program codes, the department with the most degree-granting courses in that school, and the count of such courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, STDDEV(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_cip_code, ic.cip_code_stddev, dmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, dmc.Course_Count FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, avg_cip_code, cip_code_stddev FROM inner_cte ORDER BY avg_cip_code DESC LIMIT 10 ) ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Course_Count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dmc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = dmc.SCHOOL_NAME AND dmc.Course_Count = ( SELECT MAX(sub.Course_Count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS Course_Count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s2 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c2 ON s2.SUBJECT_CODE = c2.COURSE WHERE c2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s2.SCHOOL_NAME = ic.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub ) ORDER BY ic.avg_cip_code DESC;

question: For each department, what is the minimum total units and average lecture units for subjects where the total units are between 6 and 15 or the lecture units are at least 3, only including departments whose department code is not 'NIE' and that are degree-granting, and only for the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Then, for each department, what is the highest average lecture units among these departments? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sdo ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE (ccso.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 15 OR ccso.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3) AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE != 'NIE' AND sdo.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(avg_lecture_units) AS highest_avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each academic building at MIT, show the building name, the total number of rooms with access level 1 or 2, and the average and variance of the area of those rooms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, r.AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' ) SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN inner_cte ic ON b.BUILDING_NAME = ic.BUILDING_NAME WHERE r.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY total_rooms DESC;

question: For each department that offered at least one tip subject in the term '2019FA', what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered by that department, and what is the total number of library subjects offered by that department in that term? Only include departments that offered at least 5 library subjects in '2019FA'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, COUNT(*) AS num_library_subjects FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the term '2019FA' by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the offering department name, the full department name, and the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group, ordered by the offering department name, and only include courses with materials. Additionally, for each subject title, include a grand total of enrolled students across all offering departments in the format of (subject title, null, null, null, total enrolled students). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, window_column, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, window_column WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ) SELECT rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, rr.window_column, rr.total_enrolled FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ;

question: For each DLC key and major organization, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of organizations associated with that DLC key and major organization, considering only DLC keys and major organizations that are not null, organizations that have a non-null organization name, and excluding organizations with the name 'ADMISSIONS'? Include subtotals for each DLC key (the corresponding DLC key field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all DLC keys (the corresponding DLC key field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the DLC key if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by DLC key and major organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, fo.MAJOR_ORG, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fdlk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND fo.MAJOR_ORG IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY, fo.MAJOR_ORG ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dlc_key) OVER (ORDER BY dlc_key_sort, dlc_key, major_org_sort) = dlc_key THEN NULL ELSE dlc_key END AS dlc_key, major_org, org_count_range, org_count_variance, org_count_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(dlc_key) = 1 AND GROUPING(major_org) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE dlc_key END AS dlc_key_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(dlc_key) = 0 AND GROUPING(major_org) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(dlc_key) = 1 AND GROUPING(major_org) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE dlc_key END AS dlc_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(dlc_key) = 0 AND GROUPING(major_org) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE major_org END AS major_org_sort, major_org, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY dlc_key, major_org WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dlc_key_sort, major_org_sort;

question: For each department hierarchy, what is the department hierarchy name, the average and variance of the organization numbers for organizations within that hierarchy (considering only organizations that have a non-null description and excluding organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'), and whether the average organization number is at least 10% higher or lower than the overall average across all hierarchies? Classify each as 'HIGH_AVG_ORG_NUMBER', 'LOW_AVG_ORG_NUMBER', or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.avg_org_number, i.org_number_variance, CASE WHEN i.avg_org_number > o.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVG_ORG_NUMBER' WHEN i.avg_org_number < o.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVG_ORG_NUMBER' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS avg_org_number_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_org_number) AS overall_avg FROM inner_cte ) o ORDER BY i.org_number_variance DESC;

question: Show the department names from the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program (excluding Chemistry), the number of unique subjects they offered, and for each, the corresponding term code and the number of subjects offered in the same term in the TIP subject offerings. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tip ON so.TERM_CODE = tip.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.TERM_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.num_subjects_offered, tip_counts.num_tip_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT tip.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT tip.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_tip_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tip GROUP BY tip.TERM_CODE ) tip_counts ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = tip_counts.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.num_subjects_offered DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are marked as the current term in the term parameter table and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), and the term description for each term included? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation, aca.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, aca.TERM_CODE HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, aca.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each department, what is the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and departments that are degree granting, but excluding the Chemistry department), and the number of graduate students in that department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department in the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program in 2012, what is the average total number of units for subjects with a cluster type of "SWE: School-Wide Electives", and how does each department's average compare to the overall average? Classify each department as 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' if its average is at least 10% higher than the overall average, 'BELOW_AVERAGE' if at least 10% lower, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = sos.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE so.TERM_CODE LIKE '2012%' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) , overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.avg_units, o.overall_avg_units, CASE WHEN d.avg_units > o.overall_avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN d.avg_units < o.overall_avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS department_performance FROM dept_avg d CROSS JOIN overall_avg o;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and for Mathematics (Course 18) subjects offered in terms where the material status is 'U', what is the geometric mean of the total units, and how does this geometric mean deviate from the average geometric mean across all academic years? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.geometric_mean_total_units, (i.geometric_mean_total_units - s.avg_geometric_mean) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_total_units) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte ) s ON 1=1 ORDER BY i.geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the minimum, maximum, and average number of TIP materials per subject offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have at least one TIP material, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cca JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON cca.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND cca.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(inner_cte.num_tip_materials) AS min_tip_materials, MAX(inner_cte.num_tip_materials) AS max_tip_materials, AVG(inner_cte.num_tip_materials) AS avg_tip_materials FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18) that have a non-null subject title, belong to degree-granting departments, and are offered in the current academic year, show the department full name, subject title, subject code description, school name, and the total number of such courses per department. Only include departments with at least 5 such courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_course_counts.total_courses FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte WHERE SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ) dept_course_counts ON ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = dept_course_counts.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME

question: For each building type, what is the building type name, the geometric mean of the area of rooms (AREA) in buildings of that type (considering only rooms with area greater than 0 and buildings with more than 0 rooms), and the total number of rooms per building type, only including buildings that are academic buildings and are located at MIT? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, EXP(AVG(LOG(fr.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 0 AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE ) SELECT inner_cte.building_type_name, inner_cte.geometric_mean_area, Total_Rooms.total_rooms FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 0 AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE ) AS Total_Rooms ON inner_cte.building_type_name = Total_Rooms.building_type_name;

question: For each IAP activity offered in the 2021 January term that is associated with at least one subject with more than 3 lecture units and offered by the Mathematics department, show the activity title, the term description, the maximum number of lecture units among its associated catalog subjects, and the total number of such Mathematics subjects per activity. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(inner_cte.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_math_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(inner_cte.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3;

question: For each department that offered at least 5 subjects in 2021, excluding the Chemistry department, list the department code, department name, school name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, and for each subject, show the subject code, subject code description, and the course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.num_subjects_offered, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = sc.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY inner_cte.num_subjects_offered DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each school, among the departments (excluding the Political Science department), which department has the highest variance in subject codes, and what are the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the subject codes for that department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Department_With_Highest_Subject_Code_Variance, stats.subject_code_variance, stats.subject_code_stddev FROM ( SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(CAST(ssc.SUBJECT_CODE AS SIGNED)) AS subject_code_variance, STDDEV(CAST(ssc.SUBJECT_CODE AS SIGNED)) AS subject_code_stddev FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ssc.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) stats JOIN inner_cte ic ON stats.SCHOOL_NAME = ic.SCHOOL_NAME AND stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(subject_code_variance) AS max_variance FROM ( SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(CAST(ssc.SUBJECT_CODE AS SIGNED)) AS subject_code_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ssc.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) sub GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) maxvar ON stats.SCHOOL_NAME = maxvar.SCHOOL_NAME AND stats.subject_code_variance = maxvar.max_variance ORDER BY stats.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each course in the Mathematics department that is degree granting, has a course level of 'G', and is offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the course description, department name, school name, and the administrative department name, but only include those courses where the course's CIP program code is greater than the average CIP program code for all degree granting graduate-level courses in the Mathematics department. Also, include a dense rank over the administrative department name ordered by the administrative department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), avg_cip AS ( SELECT AVG(CAST(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE AS FLOAT)) AS avg_cip FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.admin_dept_dense_rank FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cip a WHERE i.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > a.avg_cip;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments (excluding 'Mathematics'), and also include the total number of courses offered by each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(icte.subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(icte.subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC;
